summary: Comprehensive backend (pytest, 16 tests) and frontend (Playwright) testing of the 18th Green Atlas FRM demo. All backend endpoints for the golden path, MARGARET, elicited-context, obligation actions (escalate/resolve), portfolio flagging, and reset passed. Frontend UI covered: landing lens entry, fiduciary dashboard, complete golden path stepper (upload -> verify -> create -> approve), timeline event expansion and v2 vs v3 State Comparison, Obligations OPEN/SATISFIED, Fiduciary RAC, Beneficiary Home + Margaret ask+reply, Oversight attention queue + matter escalate, resolve creating v4.0, and reset back to v2.0. Everything works end-to-end.

issues: React Router future-flag console warnings (v7_startTransition, v7_relativeSplatPath) - non-blocking cosmetic

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 631 lines with seed data + all routes; consider splitting into seed.py + routes/ modules for maintainability.

get_state() may return None; verify-claims / create-changeset / approve-changeset call ensure_seed only indirectly through upload; direct access after DB flush could raise. Not currently reachable via UI but worth a defensive ensure_seed at top of each mutation route.
CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True is a subtle security misconfig (browsers ignore credentials with wildcard). Fine for demo.
React Router v6 future-flag warnings should be silenced by adding the future flags on <BrowserRouter> for cleanliness.
seed_data_creation: None; used demo seed and POST /api/reset before/after runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and auto-reset via a module-scoped fixture. All 16 pass. Golden path frontend flow works with the data-testids listed in the review request (use-demo-source, verify-claims-btn, create-changeset-btn, approve-changeset-btn, timeline-event-evt_succession, timeline-view-compare, resolve-obligation-btn, ask-margaret-btn, margaret-input, margaret-send, attention-ATL-HAR-00217, oversight-escalate/assign/acknowledge, reset-demo-btn). MatterContext refresh after each mutation is working (UI reflected v3.0/SUPERSEDED immediately after approve).
